responsibility: Declares the predicate-analysis framework used to model control-dependent conditions in GIMPLE SSA diagnostics. It defines pred_info, pred_chain, and predicate representations for normalized boolean formulas, plus the uninit_analysis interface that computes guarding predicates for PHI definitions and uses and lets clients decide whether a use is safely dominated by conditions excluding problematic paths.
same_name_distinction: Defines the predicate-analysis types and public interfaces—pred_info, pred_chain/predicate, and uninit_analysis—while the .cc file supplies the concrete normalization, comparison, and guarded-use analysis implementations.
